LESSON: PHONOLOGICAL AWARENESS: PRONUNCIATION

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.4: Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What do you do on different days of the week?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use appropriate pronunciation to outline the days of the week
2. respond to simple instructions correctly

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. use appropriate pronunciation to outline the days of the week
   In simple words: practise until you can use appropriate pronunciation to outline the days of the week. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. respond to simple instructions correctly
   In simple words: practise until you can respond to simple instructions correctly. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation in the examples.
2. Explain Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.
4. Show that you can: use appropriate pronunciation to outline the days of the week

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Listen to a short presentation on what people do on different days of the week,
2. Communication and collaboration: This is enhanced as the learner listens engages actively when answering questions related to the presentation orally. 8

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What do you do on different days of the week?
2. Why are instructions important?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. use appropriate pronunciation to outline the days of the week
2. respond to simple instructions correctly

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
